paragraphs: Rabbi Elyakum, Rava’s attendant, Avodah Zarah 58a, and his student. Rav Acha spoke in his name. In Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani’s name. Elyakum, Rabbi Yochanan’s father (see there; requires examination). Rabbi Yose ben Elyakum; Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakum.
